summary: Frontend responsive testing of Vidhata single-page site (Vite+React+TS). Verified branding, no horizontal overflow across 17 viewport widths (320-2560px), desktop nav at 1024/1280, mobile hamburger flow (open/close/link/Escape/body-lock/overlay), Hero layout at 320/375/640, WorkInAction captions visible on mobile & hover-only on desktop, RecognitionSection cert image not overflowing at 375, Contact form inputs fit at 375, and footer quick-link anchors. Zero console errors. All targeted responsive fixes verified.
critical_code_review_comments: WorkInAction section has no id attribute; other sections use ids (home/about/programs/partners/recognitions/team/contact). Consider adding id="work" for anchor consistency (not currently linked from nav/footer, so non-blocking).
Supervisor `frontend` and `backend` programs are in FATAL state; the app is served via a manually launched `yarn dev` (as noted in the request). Fine for preview but not production-managed.
23 elements match the .group selector site-wide; if any future non-gallery element uses `.group` class, hover states on desktop could conflict. Consider a more specific class for gallery items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is Vite (not CRA) served by `yarn dev` on localhost:3000; no .env, no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. No data-testids in legacy site — drive by visible text/aria-label. Mobile menu button aria-label toggles between 'Open menu' and 'Close menu' with aria-controls='mobile-menu'. Sections have ids: home, about, programs, partners, recognitions, team, contact (WorkInAction has none). Certificate image is inside .certificate-frame img. Gallery caption overlays use classes 'opacity-100 lg:opacity-0 lg:group-hover:opacity-100'.

detailed_results.horizontal_overflow: PASS for all widths [320,360,375,390,414,430,540,640,768,820,912,1024,1280,1440,1536,1920,2560] — scrollWidth == innerWidth at every breakpoint.
detailed_results.nav_desktop_1024_1280: PASS — Home, About Us, Programs, Partners, Recognitions, Our Team, Contact, Join Us all visible on one line at both 1024px and 1280px.
detailed_results.nav_mobile_375: PASS — hamburger visible, click opens #mobile-menu with all 8 links, body overflow locked to hidden, overlay element present. About Us link click closes menu and scrolls. Escape key closes menu.
detailed_results.hero_320: PASS — 'Empowering Students' heading width 288px within 320px viewport, no overflow.
detailed_results.hero_buttons_stack: PASS — 'Get Involved' and 'Learn more' stacked vertically at 375px (different top positions), inline at 640px (same top).
detailed_results.workinaction_captions_mobile: PASS — 6 gallery items show captions with opacity=1 at 375px (Interactive Learning Sessions, Volunteer Training Programs, Community Workshops, Creative Arts Programs, Student Success Stories, Outdoor Learning Activities).
detailed_results.workinaction_captions_desktop: PASS — captions opacity=0 at 1440px (revealed on hover per lg:group-hover:opacity-100).
detailed_results.recognition_cert_375: PASS — certificate image width 337.5px, right edge 356.25px, fits within 375px viewport (no overflow).
detailed_results.footer_quicklinks: PASS — 7 anchor links found: #home, #about, #programs, #partners, #recognitions, #team, #contact — all resolve to existing section ids.
